prerequisites.compression_path: real FastV hook, detached hard keep

why_blocked: L_full_seq is the frozen hinge relu(kappa_t - m_t) with kappa_t = min(max(m_clean_t, 0), 1). On sample 1025 every clean Full margin is above 1, so every kappa is 1 and every hinge term is 0. The hinge gradient L2 is 0 at delta=0 and remains 0 after the one allowed +1/255 shift. The scale rule therefore has no legal lambda_seq. The raw Full margin itself has a nonzero gradient, so this is not a disconnected backward. No second probe and no hand-set coefficient were used.
